jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.description:
If you are a highly experienced Operations professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in our Southaven, MS location, as Senior Operations Manager, you will lead all aspects of plant operations, including distribution, kitting production, quality, HDE manufacturing, materials, safety, human resources, and finance. In this role, you will drive strategies and processes that ensure operational excellence, profitability, and customer satisfaction while fostering a safe and inclusive workplace.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Provide strategic leadership to the plant management team, inspiring collaboration and accountability to achieve operational goals.
- Develop and manage annual and monthly financial plans, budgets, and operating reports; present updates and recommendations to leadership.
- Oversee manufacturing plans and schedules, capital expenditure requests, and facility maintenance to ensure efficient and safe operations.
- Lead initiatives to improve responsiveness to demand changes, enhance on-time delivery, increase productivity, optimize inventory turnover, and reduce costs.
- Communicate effectively with employees and leadership, including delivering site-wide updates and participating in monthly S&OP meetings.
- Partner with Human Resources to maintain a positive work environment, ensure employee safety and security, and support staffing and development needs.
- Represent Emerson and Professional Tools within the local community and with government stakeholders.

Who You Are:
You are someone with the ability to deliver results from a strategic vantage. You are versed in financial acumen, have exceptional decision quality, and can manage complexity. You have effective communication and accountability as strengths.

For This Role, You Will Need:
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
- Minimum of seven (7) years of experience managing a high-volume manufacturing or distribution operation.
- Legal Authorization to work in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
- MBA.
- Experience with world-class companies' warehouse safety standards, OSHA, and any other applicable regulations or policies.
- Knowledge of LEAN principle, 6S, and Six Sigma.

Our Culture & Commitment to You:
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

jobs.title: Korea Finance Manager
jobs.description:
In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Establish and oversee a robust financial governance framework covering all plant financial activities in alignment with Emerson Group policies, Korea GAAP, and US GAAP.

- Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing, delivering accurate and timely reporting for group consolidation.

- Coordinate internal and external audits, provide complete supporting documentation, and ensure efficient completion.

- Implement and regularly test internal controls across procurement, production, inventory, and sales to mitigate financial risks.

- Oversee full-cycle inventory management, including counts, valuation, turnover analysis, and identification and disposal of obsolete inventory.

- Manage capital expenditure evaluation, budget control, and post-investment ROI analysis to optimize capital utilization.

- Analyze production efficiency, capacity utilization, and unit production costs, providing actionable insights for operational decisions.

- Manage VAT, corporate income tax, and other statutory tax filings.

- Collaborate with the group tax team to optimize the tax position and implement compliant tax planning strategies.

- Prepare and timely submit statutory financial statements and required regulatory reports.

- Liaise with local authorities and coordinate internal resources for compliant, timely responses to inspections, surveys, and official communications.

- Lead annual budgeting and monthly forecast (POR) cycles aligned with group financial targets and business objectives.

- Analyze variances among actual results, budget, and forecast, identify key performance drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

- Collaborate with production, procurement, supply chain, and sales teams to align financial and operational objectives.

- Represent Finance in cross-functional projects, including lean manufacturing and new product introduction.

- Ensure Finance actively supports plant-wide operational goals through effective communication and collaborative problem-solving.

Who You Are:
You collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align financial and operational objectives. You provide actionable financial insights to support decision-making. You communicate effectively in English and Korean and support operational goals through collaborative problem-solving.

For This Role, You Will Need:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience.

- Hands-on expertise in accounting, Korea GAAP and US GAAP compliance, tax, planning and compliance, and internal and external audit coordination.

- Proficiency in ERP systems.

- High competence in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for financial analysis and reporting.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Korean.

- Deep understanding of Korean tax regulations, international trade compliance, and statutory financial reporting requirements in Korea.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
- Hands-on experience with Oracle and HFM.

Our Culture and Commitment To You:
At Emerson, we value every employee’s contribution and foster a workplace built on respect, collaboration, and continuous growth. We welcome applicants with varied experiences and career paths. If you do not meet every preferred qualification but believe your skills and potential align with this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


The Korea Finance Manager is responsible for financial governance, reporting, cost control, tax and statutory compliance, financial planning and analysis, and cross-department collaboration for the plant.

jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.description:
If you are a Director of Operations professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson's Branson business has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will serve as the senior site leader for Branson facility in Nuevo Laredo, Mexico just over the border from Laredo, Texas, providing strategic and operational leadership across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Materials, Finance, Human Resources, Customer Service, Repair Operations, Purchasing, Production Planning, and Continuous Improvement. With full accountability for site performance and operational profit and loss results, you will drive business growth, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and organizational capability while ensuring a safe, efficient, and competitive manufacturing operation. Working closely with regional leadership and global functional teams, you will play a critical role in executing Branson's manufacturing strategy and delivering long-term business success.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Provide strategic leadership and overall accountability for all functions at the Nuevo Laredo manufacturing facility, ensuring alignment with business objectives while serving as the primary site representative for internal and external stakeholders.
- Build and lead a high-performing, inclusive organization by driving workforce planning, succession planning, leadership development, employee engagement, and organizational capability to support current and future business needs.
- Drive operational excellence across manufacturing operations to achieve safety, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and on-time delivery objectives while supporting domestic, international, and intercompany customer requirements.
- Own site financial performance, including full operational profit and loss responsibility, annual operating plans, forecasting, shipment and sales commitments, cost optimization initiatives, productivity improvement, and gross margin expansion.
- Lead quality and continuous improvement efforts through ISO 9001 compliance, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies to improve customer outcomes and business performance.
- Develop and execute supply chain, purchasing, inventory management, and supplier performance strategies that support operational continuity, optimize working capital, and enable successful product introductions and operational transfers.
- Ensure compliance with Emerson values, environmental, health and safety standards, ethical business practices, and applicable regulatory requirements while contributing to Branson's global manufacturing strategy and long-term growth objectives.

Who You Are:
You anticipate future trends and translate strategy into actions that create long-term value. You build strong teams by fostering collaboration, trust, and accountability while developing individuals to reach their full potential. You make sound decisions in complex and dynamic situations, balancing multiple priorities to achieve business objectives. You consistently deliver results by aligning people, processes, and resources while creating an environment where innovation and continuous improvement can thrive.
For This Role, You Will Need:
- Demonstrated experience leading a complex manufacturing or operations organization with responsibility for multiple business functions.
- Experience managing operational performance across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, customer satisfaction, and financial metrics.
- Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop leaders and teams while fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
- Strong financial acumen, including experience managing profit and loss performance, budgets, forecasting, cost optimization initiatives, and operational performance measures.
- Experience leading cross-functional collaboration and driving organizational change within a manufacturing environment.
- Working knowledge of quality systems, continuous improvement methodologies, and manufacturing best practices.
- Strong communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels of the organization.
- Fluency in English and Spanish.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
- Experience with full site leadership responsibility within a manufacturing operation.
- Experience in industrial manufacturing, automation, assembly, capital equipment, or related industries.
- Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, 5S, and other operational excellence methodologies.
- Experience supporting global operations, product transfers, and international supply chains.
- Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems and environmental, health, and safety programs.
- Experience leading inventory optimization, supplier development, and strategic sourcing initiatives.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst

- Develop a deep understanding of business strategies, processes, operations, through a data-driven perspective
- Analyze demand, bookings, backlog, inventory, supply constraints, and fulfillment performance to identify risks and opportunities
- Gather and communicate insights to drive positive business impact
- Monitor demand signals, supply risks, and customer escalations, providing timely visibility and recommendations to executive leadership
- Document business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and implement process enhancements to increase organizational efficiency

You enjoy building relationships, creating opportunities, and growing the business

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an ability to influence
- Experience working with large data sets and multiple business systems
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Business acumen and analytical capabilities; ability to use data-driven insights to make decisions and evaluate risks and opportunities.
- Experience with data management and visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, and Salesforce Analytics a plus

Overall, this role is critical in enabling effective business planning and operational execution across the ADG organization. The Business Operations Analyst will serve as a key partner and liaison across the Business Operations and Product Management teams, while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships across the organization. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity while influencing outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups.

Our Culture & Commitment to You

The successful candidate will lead teams across multiple shifts, optimize operational performance, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to support business objectives and customer satisfaction.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
- Lead daily outbound distribution operations across pick, pack, and ship functions, ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and shipped according to established service commitments.

- Balance labor resources and staffing levels to meet operational demands, productivity goals, business volume, and customer requirements.
Monitor operational workflows, identify and eliminate process bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, quality, and operational performance.
- Provide leadership and direction to supervisors, team leads, and distribution associates, including performance management, coaching, employee development, and career growth.
- Drive employee engagement and accountability through key performance indicators, operational metrics, effective onboarding, training, and continuous learning opportunities.
- Coordinate outbound transportation activities, manage carrier performance, maintain shipping schedules, and support freight optimization initiatives to improve service and cost efficiency.
- Ensure compliance with all domestic and international shipping requirements and regulations while promoting a culture of safety, operational excellence, customer service, and cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are:
You acquire data from multiple and diverse sources when solving problems. You facilitate breakthroughs by integrating diverse views and finding common ground or acceptable alternatives. You balance the interests of multiple partners while building collaborative relationships that support shared goals. You effectively communicate in various settings, including one-on-one conversations, small and large groups, and among diverse styles and organizational levels.

For This Role, You Will Need:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- Experience leading leaders, including supervisors, team leads, and frontline associates in a distribution, warehouse, manufacturing, or logistics environment.
- Experience overseeing high-volume operational workflows and meeting customer service requirements.
- Knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS), enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), and distribution technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and drive informed decisions.
- Experience managing labor planning, productivity metrics, and operational performance indicators.
- Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a safety-focused environment.
- Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.

This person will lead projects, improve processes, and help teams make better use of data. The role requires strong project management skills, experience working with teams across regions, and practical knowledge of tools such as Python, Power BI, and Snowflake.
The right candidate can turn a broad goal into a clear plan, keep the work moving, and give leaders and stakeholders an honest view of progress. They should also be comfortable analyzing data and presenting results, recommendations, and proposals.
In This Role, You Will
Lead Projects and Improve Processes
- Lead projects that involve teams and stakeholders across the organization.
- Take ownership of projects from planning through completion.
- Define the work, assign clear next steps, track progress, and keep projects moving.
- Identify risks, dependencies, and roadblocks early, then work with the right people to address them.
- Develop consistent processes for sales teams across regions.
- Lead changes that affect Software Salespeople and help teams adopt new ways of working.
- Use project management tools to organize priorities, track commitments, and reduce time spent on manual follow-up.
- Find practical ways to simplify work, save time, and improve results.

Keep Leaders and Stakeholders Informed
- Give leaders a clear and timely view of project progress, results, risks, and decisions.
- Keep stakeholders informed about what has been completed, what comes next, and where their support is needed.
- Make project information easy to find and understand.
- Raise concerns early and explain their potential effect on timelines or results.

Present Plans, Proposals, and Results
- Present project results, proposals, recommendations, and plans in a clear and concise way.
- Create and deliver presentations for leaders and other stakeholders.
- Explain complex topics in language that fits the audience.
- Use data and evidence to support recommendations.

Use Data to Guide Decisions
- Work with Business Intelligence and data teams to analyze data, identify trends, and answer business questions.
- Turn analysis into clear recommendations that teams can act on.
- Help leaders and stakeholders understand what the data means and why it matters.

Define and Track Performance
- Develop and track measures for project results, team performance, and operational efficiency.
- Create simple ways to monitor progress and make results visible.
- Use performance data to identify problems and opportunities for improvement.
- Hold owners accountable for agreed actions and deadlines.

Support Continuous Improvement
- Find ways to reduce manual work and make processes easier to follow.
- Measure whether process changes save time or improve results.
- Help teams build better habits around project management and data.
- Develop onboarding and training that covers processes, tools, and basic data practices.

Who You Are
You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. You know how to bring structure to an unclear problem, build a practical plan, and keep people focused on the goal.
You communicate directly and adjust your message to the audience. You are comfortable speaking with individuals, teams, and leaders. You can explain progress, present a recommendation, and ask for the decisions or support needed to move forward.
You do not wait until a project is off track to raise a concern. You identify problems early, work through obstacles, and keep stakeholders informed.
For This Role, You Will Need
- At least two years of experience in program or project management in a SaaS or technology environment.
- Experience serving as the main owner responsible for planning the work, tracking progress, and moving a project toward completion.
- Practical experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools.
- A record of using project management tools and practices to save time, reduce manual work, or improve execution.
- Experience giving leaders and stakeholders clear updates on progress, risks, decisions, and results.
- Experience creating and delivering presentations about project plans, proposals, recommendations, or results.
- Experience analyzing and presenting data to support business decisions.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience creating dashboards or conducting data analysis.

- Experience in customer success or software renewals.
